definition: slowly getting well again after an illness
description: A bright bedroom with a carved arch and patterned tiles, seen as a selfie. A smiling young woman with curly hair in a cream cardigan sits up in bed under a knitted blanket, holding up a mug and looking well again. A beagle walks across the bed, sniffs and licks her face, and she sips from her mug. Behind her a blonde woman in a blue jumper opens the curtains to let the sunshine in, and a man in a mustard T-shirt clears a bedside table and then stands smiling.

de.answer: Er schnüffelt am Gesicht der Frau mit den Locken.
de.question: Was macht der Beagle?

es.answer: Le está olisqueando la cara a la mujer de pelo rizado.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el beagle?

fr.answer: Il renifle le visage de la femme aux cheveux bouclés.
